measurement: Eight CPU threads for both arms; separate cold 8GiB per-arm layout caches; slice warmups excluded from full timing.

guard: Explicitly named own peer remaining host growth is cap minus session-wide PSS including descendants.
Live peer PID/start ticks and fresh status checked; completed peer contributes zero only after confirmed actual wait and absent owned session.
Guardian operates only on the new child session, retaining exact PID identity and draining owned descendants.
Plain readable project-Python argv and direct subprocess arguments; no concealed executable payload in inspected chain.
limits: 2*full_context_bytes plus 8GiB scratch is necessary preflight only; it is not an upper bound on decoder/recurrent scratch.
The parent reported original full-parent allocated/reserved peaks of 52.85GB/62.85GB. This review has not independently authenticated that numerical receipt.
Resident full-parent fit under 64GiB is not established. Stage diagnostics may fail safely under the outer guardian.
Default one full call per arm is correctness/memory qualification and an initial timing observation, not stable throughput statistics.
Physical free-memory values are boundary snapshots, and the guardian samples device/process memory; neither establishes continuous useful GPU duty.
